Wāhine in Innovation: Sarah Sun on Web3 and Artificial Intelligence in New Zealand

Meet Sarah Sun, Head of Digital and AI at Callaghan Innovation.

Together with her team, Sarah is dedicated to driving advancements in key technologies for New Zealand. Their focus includes Web3NZ, fostering an innovation community, and Artificial Intelligence (AI), collaborating with scientists to explore AI governance and trust.

Our latest video series Wāhine in Innovation celebrates and showcases the incredible talent of women in science, technology, engineering, entrepreneurship, and innovation.

Subscribe to our channel for more.
